provenance.asset_description: Pathfinder Abomination Vaults fifth edition on D and D Beyond promotional banner: The background art is of a bearded sorrowful man standing in the foreground with a demon, a large worm, and a ghostly woman in the background behind him. At the top of the banner is the Yellow Abomination Vaults Text logo. The bottom left of the banner is the Pathfinder Second Edition text logo, and the bottom right of the banner is the D and D beyond text logo
